name: application-06
title: Agent workspace
description: A Ferrowick agent workspace: sessions grouped by day with a search that go into a sheet on phones, a thread where thinking, tool calls that open to their input and result, result cards and a request waiting for Allow or Deny arrive as the agent works, and a composer that takes photos and files, tools and skills, queues what you write while the agent answers and sets how hard it thinks on a ramp of five dots you tap or drag. Plug your agent into onSend, onApprove and onDeny.
